title: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: Office for Government Policy Coordination ( Office of Planning and Coordination ), 044-200-2051
rows.text_en: Office for Government Policy Coordination ( Office of Planning and Coordination ), 044-200-2051

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the “Regulations on the Prevention and Resolution of Conflicts in Public Institutions” and matters necessary for its implementation.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Regulations on the Prevention and Resolution of Conflicts in Public Institutions” and matters necessary for its implementation.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Scope of Application) In Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the *Regulations on the Prevention and Resolution of Conflicts in Public Institutions* (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”),the term “agencies under the President and agencies under the Prime Minister prescribed by the Decree of the Prime Minister” refers to the agencies listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013; October 31, 2025>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Scope of Application) In Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Regulations on the Prevention and Resolution of Conflicts in Public Institutions (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “agencies under the President and agencies under the Prime Minister prescribed by the Decree of the Prime Minister” refers to the agencies listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013; October 31, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. Agency under the President: Korea Communications Commission
rows.text_en: 1. Agency under the President: Korea Communications Commission

rows.source_ko: 2. Agencies under the Prime Minister: Office of the Prime Minister, Financial Services Commission
rows.text_en: 2. Agencies under the Prime Minister: Office of the Prime Minister, Financial Services Commission

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Institutions with Optional Conflict Management Deliberation Committees) The term “institution prescribed by Decree of the Prime Minister” in the proviso to Article 11 of the Enforcement Decree refers to any of the institutions falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013; October 31, 2025; October 1, 2026>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Institutions with Optional Conflict Management Deliberation Committees) The term “institution prescribed by Decree of the Prime Minister” in the proviso to Article 11 of the Enforcement Decree refers to any of the institutions falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013; October 31, 2025; October 1, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. Ministry of Justice
rows.text_en: 1. Ministry of Justice

rows.source_ko: 2. Office for Government Policy Coordination
rows.text_en: 2. Office for Government Policy Coordination

rows.source_ko: 3. Ministry of Government Legislation
rows.text_en: 3. Ministry of Government Legislation

rows.source_ko: 4. National Data Agency
rows.text_en: 4. National Data Agency

rows.source_ko: 5. Intellectual Property Office
rows.text_en: 5. Intellectual Property Office

rows.source_ko: 6. Prosecution Service
rows.text_en: 6. Prosecution Service

rows.source_ko: 6-2. Serious Crimes Investigation Agency
rows.text_en: 6-2. Serious Crimes Investigation Agency

rows.source_ko: 7. Korea Meteorological Administration
rows.text_en: 7. Korea Meteorological Administration

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Utilization of Participatory Decision-Making Methods) The head of a central administrative agency may utilize participatory decision-making methods pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree even in cases where a conflict impact analysis has not been conducted, in order to prevent and quickly resolve conflicts .
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Utilization of Participatory Decision-Making Methods) The head of a central administrative agency may utilize participatory decision-making methods pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree even in cases where a conflict impact analysis has not been conducted, in order to prevent and quickly resolve conflicts.

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Designation of Conflict Management Research Institutions) ① The Minister of Government Coordination may designate one or more research institutions or organizations as conflict management research institutions (hereinafter referred to as “research institutions”) pursuant to Article 24 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Designation of Conflict Management Research Institutions) ① The Minister of Government Coordination may designate one or more research institutions or organizations as conflict management research institutions (hereinafter referred to as “research institutions”) pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② In cases where a research institution is to be designated pursuant to Paragraph 1, the fact of the designation shall be published in the Official Gazette and announced through the website of the Office for Government Policy Coordination or domestic daily newspapers, etc. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>
rows.text_en: ② In cases where a research institution is to be designated pursuant to Paragraph 1, the fact of the designation shall be published in the Official Gazette and announced through the website of the Office for Government Policy Coordination or domestic daily newspapers, etc. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: Article 6 (Requirements for Research Institutions) The Minister of Government Coordination shall designate a research institution from among institutions that possess experts or organizations regarding conflict management and fall under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Requirements for Research Institutions) The Minister of Government Coordination shall designate a research institution from among institutions that possess experts or organizations regarding conflict management and fall under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. Research institutions established pursuant to the Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-funded Research Institutions, etc.
rows.text_en: 1. Research institutions established pursuant to the Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-funded Research Institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. Affiliated research institutes established in schools pursuant to Article 2 of the Higher Education Act
rows.text_en: 2. Affiliated research institutes established in schools pursuant to Article 2 of the Higher Education Act

rows.source_ko: 3. A non-profit corporation or its affiliated research institute pursuant to Article 32 of the Civil Act
rows.text_en: 3. A non-profit corporation or its affiliated research institute pursuant to Article 32 of the Civil Act

rows.source_ko: 4. Corporate Research Institute
rows.text_en: 4. Corporate Research Institute

rows.source_ko: Article 7 (Application for Designation) ① Any person who wishes to be designated as a research institutionshall submit the application for designation as an institution in the attached form and the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs to the Minister of Government Coordination. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Designation) ① Any person who wishes to be designated as a research institution shall submit the application for designation as an institution in the attached form and the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs to the Minister of Government Coordination. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. Business plan for each subparagraph of Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree
rows.text_en: 1. Business plan for each subparagraph of Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation (limited to corporations)
rows.text_en: 2. Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation (limited to corporations)

rows.source_ko: 3. General Overview of the Applicant Organization (Organizational Structure, Major Duties, and Personnel Status, etc.)
rows.text_en: 3. General Overview of the Applicant Organization (Organizational Structure, Major Duties, and Personnel Status, etc.)

rows.source_ko: 4. Other documents required for designation review
rows.text_en: 4. Other documents required for designation review

rows.source_ko: ② A research institution whose designation period has expired pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 may also apply for designation, and in this case, must also submit the documents pursuant to Paragraph 1.
rows.text_en: ② A research institution whose designation period has expired pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 may also apply for designation, and in this case, must also submit the documents pursuant to Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ The application period for designation as a research institution shall be at least 30 days.
rows.text_en: ③ The application period for designation as a research institution shall be at least 30 days.

rows.source_ko: ④ Designation applications are accepted via electronic submission and mail.
rows.text_en: ④ Designation applications are accepted via electronic submission and mail.

rows.source_ko: Article 8 (Composition and Operation of the Review Committee) ① The Minister of Government Coordination shall constitute a Review Committee consisting of no more than seven members, including one Chairperson, for the purpose of designating research institutions. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Composition and Operation of the Review Committee) ① The Minister of Government Coordination shall constitute a Review Committee consisting of no more than seven members, including one Chairperson, for the purpose of designating research institutions. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 심사위원회의 위원은 관계 공무원과 관련분야에 대해 풍부한 경험과 지식을 가진 민간 전문가로 구성한다.
rows.text_en: ② The members of the review committee shall consist of relevant public officials and private experts with extensive experience and knowledge in the relevant field.

rows.source_ko: ③ 심사위원회의 위원장은 국무조정실 국정운영실장이 되고, 관계 공무원은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 이에 상당하는 공무원 중에서 국무조정실장이 지명하는 자가 된다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Chairperson of the Review Committee shall be the Head of the Office for Government Affairs at the Office for Government Policy Coordination, and the relevant public officials shall be those designated by the Head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service or public servants equivalent thereto. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>
④ Deleted <2009. 1. 2.>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 심사위원회는 재적위원 3분의 2 이상의 출석으로 개의하고, 출석위원 과반수 찬성으로 의결한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Review Committee shall convene with the attendance of at least two-thirds of its members and make decisions by a majority vote of the members present.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(지정사실의 통지) ① 국무조정실장은 제8조제5항에 따라 연구기관이 지정된 경우 다음 각 호의 사항을 관보에 게재하고 홈페이지 등을 통해 공개하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Notification of Designation) ① When a research institution is designated pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 5, the Minister of Government Coordination shall publish the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs in the Official Gazette and disclose them through the website, etc. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 지정된 연구기관의 명칭과 주소
rows.text_en: 1. Name and address of the designated research institution

rows.source_ko: 2. 지정연월일 및 지정기간
rows.text_en: 2. Date of Designation and Designation Period

rows.source_ko: 3. 주요 기능 및 역할
rows.text_en: 3. Key Functions and Roles

rows.source_ko: ② 국무조정실장은 연구기관이 지정된 날로부터 7일 이내에 연구기관 지정사실을 해당 연구기관의 장에게 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Government Coordination shall notify the head of the relevant research institution of the fact of designation within 7 days from the date of designation. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(지정기간) ① 연구기관의 지정 기간은 3년을 원칙으로 한다. 다만, 국무조정실장이 과제수행 기간의 연장, 과제의 일관성 유지 등을 위해 지정기간 연장이 필요하다고 판단하는 경우에는 최대 2년까지 기간을 연장할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Designation Period) ① In principle, the designation period for a research institution shall be three years. However, if the Minister of Government Coordination determines that an extension of the designation period is necessary to extend the project execution period or maintain project consistency, the period may be extended by up to two years. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 국무조정실장은 제1항에 따른 지정기간이 만료되기 전 3개월까지 지정된 연구기관의 장에게 기간의 종료 통지나 기간 연장에 관한 통지를 하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Government Coordination shall notify the head of the designated research institution of the termination of the period or of the extension of the period no later than three months prior to the expiration of the designation period under Paragraph 1. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(경비의 지원과 관리) ① 연구기관의 장은 영 제24조제2항에 따라 지원되는 경비를 해당 사업수행에 필요한 용도에 한하여 사용하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Support and Management of Expenses) ① The head of a research institution shall use the expenses supported pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree only for purposes necessary for the execution of the relevant project.

rows.source_ko: ② 국무조정실장은 연구기관의 경비사용 내역을 확인할 필요가 있다고 판단하는 경우 연구기관의 장에게 경비사용 내역을 제출하도록 요구할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② If the Minister of Government Coordination determines that it is necessary to verify the details of expense usage by a research institution, he/she may require the head of the research institution to submit such details. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 경비사용 내역 제출을 요구받은 연구기관의 장은 이를 지체없이 국무조정실장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of a research institution who has been requested to submit details of expense usage pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall submit them to the Minister of Government Coordination without delay. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(시정요구) 국무조정실장은 연구기관으로 지정된 자가 과제수행 내용을 위반하거나 제11조제1항을 위반하는 경우에는 시정을 요구할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Request for Correction) The Minister of Government Coordination may request correction if a person designated as a research institution violates the contents of the project execution or violates Article 11, Paragraph 1. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(연구결과물의 제출) 연구기관으로 지정된 자는 매년 12월 31일까지 연구실적, 교육훈련실시 결과 등을 국무조정실장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Submission of Research Results) Any person designated as a research institution shall submit research achievements, results of education and training, etc., to the Minister of Government Coordination by December 31 of each year. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제14조(갈등관리실태의 점검 등) 국무조정실장은 영 제26조제1항에 따라 중앙행정기관의 갈등관리실태 등을 점검하고자 하는 경우에 특별한 사유가 없는 한 미리 다음 각 호의 사항을 명시하여 관계 행정기관에 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Inspection of Conflict Management Status, etc.) Where the Minister of Government Coordination intends to inspect the conflict management status, etc. of central administrative agencies pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall, unless there are special circumstances, notify the relevant administrative agencies in advance by specifying the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 점검사항
rows.text_en: 1. Inspection Items

rows.source_ko: 2. 점검일정
rows.text_en: 2. Inspection Schedule

rows.source_ko: 3. 점검자 인적사항
rows.text_en: 3. Inspector's Personal Information

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 점검에 필요하다고 판단되는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters deemed necessary for the inspection

rows.source_ko: 제15조(갈등관리정책협의회 구성 및 운영) ① 영 제26조제5항에 따른 갈등관리정책협의회(이하 “정책협의회”라 한다)는 위원장 1명을 포함한 25명 이내의 위원으로 구성한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Composition and Operation of Conflict Management Policy Council) ① The Conflict Management Policy Council pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “Policy Council”) shall be composed of no more than 25 members, including one chairperson.

rows.source_ko: ② 위원장은 국무조정실장이 되고, 위원은 재정경제부차관, 과학기술정보통신부차관, 교육부차관, 국방부차관, 행정안전부차관, 문화체육관광부차관, 농림축산식품부차관, 산업통상부차관, 보건복지부차관, 기후에너지환경부차관, 고용노동부차관, 성평등가족부차관, 국토교통부차관, 해양수산부차관, 방송미디어통신위원회부위원장, 소방청장, 국가유산청장, 산림청장, 그 밖에 위원장이 필요하다고 인정하는 관계부처 또는 청의 차관, 차장 또는 청장이 된다. 이 경우 복수차관이 있는 기관은 해당 기관의 장이 지정하는 차관으로 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 8. 10., 2025. 10. 31., 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The Chairperson shall be the Head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, and the members shall be the Vice Minister of Finance and Economy, the Vice Minister of Science and ICT, the Vice Minister of Education, the Vice Minister of National Defense, the Vice Minister of the Interior and Safety, the Vice Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Vice Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Vice Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, the Vice Minister of Health and Welfare, the Vice Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, the Vice Minister of Employment and Labor, the Vice Minister of Gender Equality and Family, the Vice Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Vice Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries, the Vice Chairperson of the Korea Communications Commission, the Commissioner of the National Fire Agency, the Administrator of the National Heritage Administration, the Administrator of the Korea Forest Service, and other Vice Ministers, Deputy Heads, or Heads of relevant ministries or agencies that the Chairperson deems necessary. In this case, for agencies with multiple Vice Ministers, the members shall be the Vice Minister designated by the head of the relevant agency. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Aug. 10, 2017; Oct. 31, 2025; Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 정책협의회는 다음 각 호의 사항을 심의ㆍ조정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Policy Council shall deliberate and coordinate the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 공공갈등 예방과 해결을 위한 법령정비 등 제도개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning institutional improvements, such as the revision of laws and regulations, for the prevention and resolution of public conflicts

rows.source_ko: 2. 공공갈등과 관련된 교육ㆍ홍보에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning education and public relations related to public conflicts

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 위원장이 공공갈등과 관련하여 정책협의회의 심의가 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters concerning public conflicts that the Chairperson deems necessary to deliberate at the Policy Consultative Council.

rows.source_ko: ④ 정책협의회의 사무를 처리하기 위하여 간사 1명을 두되, 간사는 국무조정실 국정운영실장이 된다. <개정 2008. 7. 2., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ One secretary shall be appointed to handle the affairs of the Policy Consultative Council, and the Director of the Office for Government Affairs at the Office for Government Policy Coordination shall serve as the secretary. <Amended July 2, 2008; March 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(회의) ① 위원장은 정책협의회의 회의를 소집하며 그 의장이 된다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Meetings) ① The Chairperson shall convene meetings of the Policy Consultative Council and preside over them.

rows.source_ko: ② 정책협의회의 회의는 재적위원 과반수의 출석으로 개의하고, 출석위원 과반수의 찬성으로 의결한다.
rows.text_en: ② Meetings of the Policy Consultative Council shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of the registered members and decisions shall be made by the approval of a majority of the members present.

rows.source_ko: Article 17 (Request for Cooperation from Related Agencies, etc.) When necessary for the performance of its duties, the Policy Council may invite relevant public officials or experts with specialized knowledge and experience to attend and hear their opinions, or request necessary cooperation from relevant agencies and organizations, such as the submission of materials and opinions.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Request for Cooperation from Related Agencies, etc.) When necessary for the performance of its duties, the Policy Council may invite relevant public officials or experts with specialized knowledge and experience to attend and hear their opinions, or request necessary cooperation from relevant agencies and organizations, such as the submission of materials and opinions.

rows.source_ko: Article 18 (Allowances and Travel Expenses) Members and relevant experts attending the Review Committee pursuant to Article 8 and the Policy Consultation Council pursuant to Article 15 may be paid allowances, travel expenses, and other necessary expenses within the limits of the budget. However, this shall not apply to public officials attending in direct relation to their assigned duties.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Allowances and Travel Expenses) Members and relevant experts attending the Review Committee pursuant to Article 8 and the Policy Consultation Council pursuant to Article 15 may be paid allowances, travel expenses, and other necessary expenses within the limits of the budget. However, this shall not apply to public officials attending in direct relation to their assigned duties.
